$doc: Reusable music-library catalog. Tracks listed here are PERMANENT and reused across many videos (Mike's go-to ~20-30 beds). Project-only/trial downloads live in that project's media folder, NOT here; promote a track here only once it's a reusable keeper. Sourcing tool: video-creation/skills/music-sourcing/ (renamed from music/ on 2026-06-13). LICENSING IS SOURCE-SPECIFIC: Soundstripe tracks carry a yt_license_code (16-char, bare code) that MUST be pasted into the YOUTUBE description ONLY (Soundstripe clearance is YouTube Content-ID; NOT needed on FB/IG) or the YT upload gets claimed; Envato Elements tracks have no per-video code, they use the Elements license certificate tied to the item/register. metadata_complete=false means the Soundstripe genre/mood/bpm fields still need backfilling via the sourcing tool (by soundstripe_id).
$schema_note: energy_measured is ffmpeg volumedetect mean/max dBFS (rough loudness proxy: higher mean = louder/fuller = more 'exciting'). Real Soundstripe 'energy'/'mood'/'genre' come from the API when enriched.
